## Rows

| dice | result | effect | severity | notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 11-13 | Nervous Opening | Your first notes are shaky and the crowd notices. The scene starts poorly, and any recovery attempt from this performance is spoiled. | Low |  |
| 14-16 | Forgotten Words | You forget lyrics, cues, or lines. The performance stalls as you scramble to recover your place. | Low |  |
| 21-23 | Hoarse Voice | Your throat gives out or your breath runs short. Suffer 1 point of damage to Empathy. | Moderate |  |
| 24-26 | Broken Prop | A string snaps, a drum tears, or a costume piece fails. The act cannot continue until you repair or replace the prop. | Low |  |
| 31-33 | Misread Audience | You read the room wrong and play the wrong mood. The audience grows cold, and their attitude drops one step. | Moderate |  |
| 34-36 | Offensive Verse | You sing or play something taboo, insulting, or politically dangerous. Someone in the crowd takes offense and may confront you. | High |  |
| 41-43 | Stage Fright | Panic hits mid-performance. Suffer 1 point of damage to Empathy and lose your nerve before the next scene. | Moderate |  |
| 44-46 | Rival Interruption | A rival performer, heckler, or loud patron cuts in and steals the spotlight. You lose control of the moment and the performance ends early. | Moderate |  |
| 51-53 | Thrown Objects | The crowd turns hostile and throws bottles, fruit, or worse. Suffer an attack with four Base Dice, causing damage to Empathy. | High |  |
| 54-56 | False Blasphemy | Your song is mistaken for mockery or sacrilege. Guards, zealots, or angry villagers demand answers or force you out. | High |  |
| 61-63 | Crushing Crowd | The audience surges forward, trampling props and jostling you hard. Suffer 1 point of damage to Strength or Agility, GM's choice. | Severe |  |
| 64-66 | Riot Spark | Your performance ignites panic or violence in the crowd. A riot or brawl breaks out, and you are caught in the center of it. | Catastrophic |  |
